biological.citation: Identification of Variant-Specific Functions of PIK3CA by Rapid Phenotyping of Rare Mutations (PMID: 26627007)
biological.summary: PIK3CA encodes the catalytic subunit alpha of PI3K. High-throughput screening of PIK3CA variants in cell growth and transformation assays revealed variant-specific activation of PI3K signaling and MEK1/2 pathway activation, demonstrating that oncogenic activity correlates imperfectly with mutation frequency.
biological.significance: Mutations >5% frequency significantly more oncogenic than wild-type (p<0.05)

biological.citation: PIK3CA gain-of-function mutation in Schwann cells leads to severe neuropathy and aerobic glycolysis through a non-cell autonomous effect (PMID: 40553493)
biological.summary: PIK3CA gain-of-function mutations activate PI3K signaling and trigger metabolic shift toward glycolytic activation. PIK3CA-mutated cells communicate with neighboring healthy cells (adipocytes, hair follicles) through crosstalk mechanism affecting their growth and proliferation.
biological.sample_size: Mouse model with Schwann cell-specific PIK3CA mutation
biological.significance: Early alpelisib treatment significantly improved disease signs; delayed treatment less effective

biological.citation: Organismal metabolism regulates the expansion of oncogenic PIK3CA mutant clones in normal esophagus (PMID: 39169259)
biological.summary: PIK3CA H1047R mutation activates PI3K-mTOR pathway, increasing mutant cell competitive fitness. Metabolic conditions (obesity, type 1 diabetes) enhance PIK3CA mutant cell advantage, while metformin reduces it, demonstrating metabolic environment selectively influences PIK3CA mutant evolution.
biological.sample_size: Transgenic mice; primary esophageal keratinocytes; human esophageal samples
biological.significance: Higher PIK3CA mutation density in esophagus of high BMI individuals vs. normal weight (p<0.05)

biological.citation: Somatic activating mutations in Pik3ca cause sporadic venous malformations in mice and humans (PMID: 27030595)
biological.summary: PIK3CA H1047R (constitutively active p110α mutant) causes endothelial cell hyperproliferation, reduced pericyte coverage, and decreased arteriovenous specification markers. PI3K pathway inhibition with rapamycin normalized EC hyperproliferation and stimulated venous malformation regression in vivo.
biological.sample_size: Mouse model; human venous malformation samples
biological.significance: Rapamycin treatment normalized EC hyperproliferation and pericyte coverage in postnatal retinas

biological.citation: The role of PIK3CA gene mutations in colorectal cancer and the selection of treatment strategies (PMID: 39555098)
biological.summary: PIK3CA encodes p110α catalytic subunit of PI3K, which regulates PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling pathway. PIK3CA mutations (15-20% of CRC patients) cause persistent pathway activation promoting proliferation, invasion, metastasis, and drug resistance.

biological.citation: Methylation of the chromatin modifier KMT2D by SMYD2 contributes to therapeutic response in hormone-dependent breast cancer (PMID: 38700982)
biological.summary: PIK3CA activating mutations in ER+ breast cancer activate PI3K pathway, which regulates ER activity through KMT2D phosphorylation. SMYD2-mediated KMT2D methylation fine-tunes response to PI3K/AKT inhibitors and endocrine therapy.
biological.sample_size: Breast cancer cell lines; patient-derived organoids; tumor models
biological.significance: SMYD2 inhibition sensitizes cells to PI3K/AKT inhibition and endocrine therapy

biological.citation: Oncogenic PIK3CA corrupts growth factor signaling specificity (PMID: 39706867)
biological.summary: PIK3CA H1047R oncogene corrupts fidelity of growth factor-induced PI3K/AKT information transfer in a dose-dependent manner, preferentially amplifying EGFR signaling responses compared to IGF1 and insulin receptor signaling while enhancing signaling heterogeneity.
biological.sample_size: Human cervical cancer cells; induced pluripotent stem cells
biological.significance: Dose-dependent effects on signaling fidelity and heterogeneity

biological.citation: Neddylation as a target in PIK3CA-mutated head and neck cancer (PMID: 40154000)
biological.summary: CRISPRi genome-wide screening in PIK3CA E545K-mutated HNSCC identified 34 co-dependent genes including 5 neddylation pathway genes (NEDD8, NEDD8-MDP-1, NAE1, USP8, UBA3), revealing novel regulatory mechanism and therapeutic vulnerability.
biological.significance: Neddylation genes identified as essential co-dependencies with PIK3CA E545K

biological.citation: PIK3CA Mutations Downregulate PPT1 to Promote Adipogenesis by Suppressing P300 Depalmitoylation and Phase Separation (PMID: 41610323)
biological.summary: PIK3CA mutations transcriptionally repress PPT1 via PI3K-AKT-c-JUN signaling. Downregulated PPT1 enhances P300 palmitoylation, stabilizing P300 and inhibiting its phase separation, thereby promoting chromatin accessibility and adipogenic gene expression.
biological.sample_size: Primary human FIL adipose-derived stem cells; immortalized cell lines; mouse models
biological.significance: Novel palmitoylation-phase separation-epigenetic regulation axis identified

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Multi-ancestry genome-wide meta-analysis in Parkinson's disease (J. Kim et al.)
biological.summary: PIK3CA identified as a novel genome-wide significant locus associated with Parkinson's disease risk in multi-ancestry meta-analysis, suggesting PI3K pathway involvement in PD pathogenesis.
biological.sample_size: 49,049 PD cases, 18,785 proxy cases, 2,458,063 controls across multiple ancestries

biological.citation: ASHG 2023 - Leveraging Mosaic Epileptogenic Human Brain Tissue to Study Cell-type Specific Transcriptional Changes Associated with a Pathogenic PIK3CA Variant (M. Gade et al.)
biological.summary: PIK3CA E545K somatic variant in hemimegalencephaly brain tissue activates mTOR pathway and CREB phosphorylation pathway in neurons. Single-cell genotyping and transcriptomics revealed cell-type-specific transcriptional effects including upregulation of SPDYE5.
biological.sample_size: Surgically resected brain tissue from HMEG patient; 44 NeuN+ nuclei sequenced
biological.significance: mTOR pathway activation confirmed in PIK3CA-positive neurons
